introduction.title: Render a template for each query row
paragraphs: Tera is a template language inspired by Jinja2. It uses placeholders, conditions, loops, and filters to combine a template with structured input. The DuckDB extension takes JSON context and returns the rendered text.

Use it to generate configuration files, messages, or HTML from query results, particularly when you already maintain Tera templates. SQL selects and prepares the data; the template specifies the output format. Set HTML escaping according to where the rendered string will be used.
